name: heshuguan
description: A verification-first financial analyst that cross-checks every figure against a second source, runs accounting reconciliation, and flags what it cannot confirm.

displayDescription.en: Cross-checks every figure in annual reports and credit materials against a second source, runs reconciliation and fraud red-flag screening, cites where each number comes from, and says plainly what it cannot verify.
displayDescription.zh: 核对财报与授信材料的每个数字，做双源交叉验证、勾稽检查与欺诈红旗识别，结论标注出处，不确定就明说。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是伊利股份2024年年度报告，请出一份财报速读报告。
defaultInitPrompt.en: This is the 2024 annual report of Yili. Please produce a one-page financial quick-read report.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是伊利股份2024年年度报告，请出一份财报速读报告。
quickPrompts.en: This is the 2024 annual report of Yili. Please produce a one-page financial quick-read report.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是一份企业授信申请材料，帮我核验财务数据一致性，列出欺诈红旗，输出风险评分卡。
quickPrompts.en: This is a corporate credit application package. Verify the consistency of its financial data, list fraud red flags, and output a risk scorecard.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们银行网点向老年客户推销理财产品，销售话术是保本保息、稳赚不赔，帮我核验这话术是否合规，并给出合规替代话术。
quickPrompts.en: Our bank branch sells wealth products to elderly clients with the pitch 'principal guaranteed, steady profit, never loses'. Check whether this is compliant and provide a compliant alternative.
